headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Sammy Guevara vs. Andrade El Idolo went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.99. It was the first title opportunity of Andrade El Idolo's career. Sammy Guevara was chasing gold for the 10th time. An ambush by the Andrade-Hardy Family Office, with Sting and Darby Allin racing out for the save ? setting up a bigger six-man showdown between the two factions at the following Revolution pay-per-view.

On a Wednesday in 2026, back when Young Bucks & Perry vs. The Demand vs. The Young Bucks vs. The Rascalz (Wentz & Xavier) vs. FTR vs. GOA vs. Jack Perry vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Dezmond Xavier vs. Zachary Wentz vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Toa Liona vs. Ricochet settled things in a Mile High Madness match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.84 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. In a chaotic "Mile High Madness" Anything Goes brawl born out of FTR spiking the Young Bucks' kid brother with a piledriver, Jack Perry, the Bucks and the Rascalz got their revenge on FTR and The Demand in a wild ten-man war.
Flash back to 2026, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Jon Moxley and El Clon, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when Nick Comoroto was back in action after 6 months away, appearing on Rampage.
2022 brought us this moment: Orange Cassidy vs. Anthony Bowens met in a Qualifying Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 6.27.
On a Wednesday in 2026, back when it marked the first-ever meeting between Brody King and Mark Davis on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
